sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. SearchOS and DataShield were already published; MemPoison remained a fresh same-table ai-safety candidate.
Main Agent deep-read arXiv HTML/PDF and extracted taxonomy, benchmark construction, BCR tables, defense results, MID formulas, pipeline audit, and limitations.
Article separates demonstrated results from deployment claims and states limitations around text-only memory, representative substrates, offline MID cost, and missing production controls.
